title: Fail closed on DB errors and claim LINE activation codes atomically
context_summary: Adversarial review examined handover state checks, quota enforcement, and group binding.
observation: Catching non-404 DB errors permissively could bypass human takeover; non-atomic code checks allowed race conditions or cross-tenant hijack.
verified_action: Return C06_DATABASE_DEGRADED_RESPONSE on non-missing-table DB errors, claim codes via atomic RPC, and guard 0-charge quota resets.

title: Clear sticky ToolInputError flag when Jarvis self-corrects to a saved proposal while preserving hard tool failures
context_summary: Live operator run #84 ('update the ai agent team') failed after saving Proposal #2 because an earlier tool turn passed department='AI Operations'.
observation: A recoverable ToolInputError set ctx.toolFailed=true permanently, causing runJarvis to throw even after the model self-corrected and saved a valid proposal.
verified_action: Expand normalizeDepartment ('AI Operations' -> 'operations', 'After-Service' -> 'support'), track non-input/blocked failures in ctx.hardToolFailed, and clear ctx.toolFailed when saveProposal succeeds without any hardToolFailed.
